summary: Row of item tiles, per player: icon, count, key hint, one tile selected. A count that changes pulses its tile.

panels.doc: The row. Style = colour of the selected tile. InventoryOptions.Classes go here too.

A tile. Author it `hidden`. `selected` for InventoryOptions.Selected, `depleted` when the count is 0. `pulse-a` and `pulse-b` swap when the count changes: give both the same animation under two names, so each swap restarts it. Style = the tile's accent and icon tint.
The icon. `item-<name>` sets its `background-image`: one rule per item in the stylesheet (InventorySlot.Item).
Label of the count, `empty` when there is no number.
Label of the key hint, `empty` when blank.
Label of the item name, `empty` when blank. The bundled stylesheet shows it only under a `selected` tile.
